result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but a few elements look clipped or awkwardly overlapped, especially near horizontally scrolling sections and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The restaurant list content appears to continue underneath the fixed bottom navigation bar; the lower restaurant card is partially obscured by the nav area.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are fully visible above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category carousel shows a partially cut-off pill on the far right with no visible label, which can look like a broken or truncated control.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or snapping so the next item is either clearly visible as a partial preview or hidden cleanly.

issues.description: The third item in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is heavily clipped on the right side, including the restaurant name, making the row feel visually crowded.
issues.suggestion: Increase card spacing, reduce card width, or use clearer carousel affordance so the clipped item feels intentional.
